pms.invalidation: Reduce or close if the full H/M/U/Z strip re-cheapens back through roughly 3.35-3.40 with follow-through, especially if March CORRA moves back above about 3.20 and that move is confirmed by firmer Canadian underlying inflation, labor/wages, or explicitly hawkish BoC guidance. pms.label: ChatGPT
pms.mandate: Final synthesis; may trade or choose no-trade. No forced style.

positions.invalidation: Reduce or close if Canadian core inflation moves decisively above the current near-2% zone while employment and wage growth reaccelerate, or if BoC communication/delivered hikes validate a 2027 path in the mid-3% area. A headline-energy spike without confirmation in core inflation and labor is not sufficient invalidation.
positions.thesis: Receive the 2027 CORRA H/M/U/Z strip. The market prices roughly 84 to 130.5 bp of BoC tightening from a 2.29% overnight rate even though Canadian labor is weak and core inflation is near 2%; the 2027 hike cycle is too aggressive relative to the domestic reaction function.

pms.thesis: Hold the existing 2027 H/M/U/Z CORRA receive, but do not add. The exact strip has normalized materially in our favor to about 3.22 from the 3.40 entry, yet it still averages roughly 91bp above 2.31 cash and March alone remains around 2.945. Canadian underlying inflation near 1.95% and weak domestic labor still do not validate the full 2027 hike path. Brent near 102 and the LNG Canada expansion are genuine upside risks to Canadian inflation and activity, so the remaining edge is smaller and does not justify adding.

positions.thesis: Duration-long / receive MX CRAH27 (paper alias CORRA_2027-03, family locked to CORRA/CRA). Long in this book is long duration with P&L inverted in implied-rate space: profits if Mar-27 implied CORRA falls from 3.13 toward the still-alive near-term path (1m Dec-2026 2.58, 3m Dec-2026 CRAZ26 2.775), not if Canada catches up to SOFR. The 2027 contract is where the unwarranted hiking cycle is concentrated; do not migrate onto SOFR, AONIA, CA-US 2Y, or USDCAD.

pms.thesis: March 2027 CORRA still implies about 63.5bp of tightening versus 2.31 cash, which remains too much Bank of Canada path even after the contract came in 18.5bp from 3.13. Oil at 102 and UST 10s at 5.24 are the inflation-spillover risks, but they have not produced the hike path the contract still discounts. Keep the concentrated receive; do not overlay FX or a pay-side offset.

positions.invalidation: Thesis fails if BoC hikes or the 1m CORRA strip through Dec-2026 reprices toward the 2027 CRA mid-3s; if CPI-trim/median leave the 1.9/2.0 zone higher while employment stops contracting and wages re-accelerate; or if CORRA_2027-03 implied holds at or above the 3.13 entry because catch-up is actually being delivered. A US-only or energy-headline move that leaves CRAH27 unchanged is not…
positions.thesis: That is the first 2027 three-month contract that prices a Canadian hiking cycle (+84bp vs CORRA cash 2.29) after 1m CORRA still only reaches 2.58 by Dec-2026 and Dec-26 3m CRAZ26 is 2.775. August labor (-42k, wages +2.0%) and CPI-trim/median 1.9/2.0 do not support delivering that 2027 path. Side long is duration-long in implied-rate space (profits if the 3.13 implied falls toward the still-alive near-term path).

pms.thesis: Keep the existing CORRA March 2027 receive. Cash at 2.31 versus implied 2.945 still prices a re-tightening path the position is fading, and the line has already worked from 3.13 without the thesis breaking. Brent near 102 is the live hawkish-Canada risk, but the accepted expanding clips are too small to hedge that path or to add a second independent macro bet. Unused risk capacity is not a reason to overlay token AONIA, US 10-year, or CAD FX risk that either duplicates easing beta or only partially offsets it.

pms.label: Grinder
pms.mandate: Preservation and consistency first. Smaller sizes, high hurdles, quick de-risking. No-trade is valid.
pms.thesis: The book stays flat. None of the four markable expanding handoffs shows expected edge large enough to pay official SOFR 3.90 ACT/360 charged on shocked-risk capital after a 100bp rate shock or a 1 percent spot shock. Cash-versus-strip gaps and outright yield levels are priced paths, not alpha, and the FX sleeves have no stated target that covers a 1 percent adverse move.
